editorial.blurb: Gaijin masters the art of okonomiyaki, serving authentic Japanese savory pancakes cooked tableside on warm griddles with thoughtful toppings and sauces that transport you straight to Japan.
editorial.insiderTip: Come during brunch for lighter options like rice bowls, or go for the full experience and order both Osaka-style and Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki to compare—the tableside griddle setup makes it a memorable shared experience.
